description: This file defines the PowerUp class representing a power-up entity in the game. It includes properties for position, size, type, and state, along with methods for updating position and retrieving bounds.

classes.name: PowerUp
classes.description: A class representing a power-up entity in the game, with position, size, type, and methods to update its state and get its bounding box.

methods.name: constructor({ x = 0, y = 0, w = 28, h = 28, type = 'dash' } = {})
methods.description: Initializes a PowerUp instance with position, size, type, and default collected status.

methods.name: update(dt, scrollSpeed)
methods.description: Updates the position of the power-up based on scroll speed and elapsed time.

methods.name: getBounds()
methods.description: Returns the bounding box of the power-up for collision detection.
